name: ESP32 LEDC Output
description: The LEDC output component exposes an [LEDC PWM channel](https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/api-reference/peripherals/ledc.html) of the ESP32 as an output component.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: If the output should be treated as inverted. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id to use for this output component.

config_entries.label: Power Supply
config_entries.description: The [power supply](https://esphome.io/components/power_supply/) to connect to this output. When the output is enabled, the power supply will automatically be switched on too.

config_entries.label: Channel
config_entries.description: Manually set the [LEDC channel](https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/api-reference/peripherals/ledc.html#configure-channel) to use. Defaults to an automatic selection. The valid channel range depends on the ESP32 variant:

config_entries.label: Frequency
config_entries.description: At which frequency to run the LEDC channel's timer. Defaults to `1kHz`.

config_entries.label: Max Power
config_entries.description: Sets the maximum output value of this output platform. Must be in range from min_power to 1. Defaults to `1`.

config_entries.label: Min Power
config_entries.description: Sets the minimum output value of this output platform. Must be in range from 0 to max_power. Defaults to `0`. If zero_means_zero is `false` this will be output value when the entity is turned off.

config_entries.label: Phase Angle
config_entries.description: Set a phase angle to the other channel of this timer. Range 0-360°, defaults to 0°.

config_entries.label: Zero Means Zero
config_entries.description: Sets the output to use actual 0 instead of `min_power`. Defaults to `false`.
